snippet.title: Abashed Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Abashed lets you step into the troubled mind of Issac, as the fragments of his past flash before his eyes. Solve puzzles, meet mysterious characters, and alter reality as he faces his worst fears to uncover the truth behind his missing partner, or so he thought.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116230/Abashed/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
